user.title: Add a MiYue speaker
user.description: Enter the speaker's IP address. The UPnP port is found automatically (it changes across reboots).

confirm.title: Add MiYue speaker
confirm.description: Do you want to add the MiYue speaker "{name}"?

abort.not_miyue: This UPnP device is not a MiYue speaker.
abort.no_udn: The device did not report a UDN.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a MiYue speaker at that address.

play_tts.name: Play TTS
play_tts.description: Speak a text announcement on a MiYue speaker (and optionally its whole group).

announce_group.name: Announce to whole group
announce_group.description: Speak on every member if the speaker is grouped.

create_alarm.name: Create alarm
create_alarm.description: Create an alarm on a MiYue speaker.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days to repeat; omit for every day.

duration.name: Auto-stop (minutes)
duration.description: Pause the music this many minutes after start; 0 keeps playing.

songlist_id.name: Songlist id
songlist_id.description: Device songlist to play; omit for TTS-only.

tts_text.name: Spoken text
tts_text.description: Optional text spoken by the alarm.

delete_alarm.name: Delete alarm
delete_alarm.description: Delete an alarm by id (see the switch's alarm_id attribute).

create_scene.name: Create scene
create_scene.description: Create a device scene (情景) activatable from HA.

songlist_id.name: Songlist id
songlist_id.description: Device songlist to play when the scene runs.

cmd.name: Trigger code
cmd.description: Unique trigger code (KNX/RS-485/custom); auto-generated if omitted.

delete_scene.name: Delete scene
delete_scene.description: Delete a scene by id (see the scene entity's scene_id attribute).
